title: [Request] Support Claude Web Search Support
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

Anthropic have just released Claude 4 Opus and Claude 4 Sonnet. I would like to see these fully supported WITH their web-search ability like Gemini has. 

### 🧐 解决方案

The solution is to add websearch and support for the new Claude 4 models

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

1. 支持 `web_search_20250305` 内建工具及 `ANTHROPIC_MAX_USES` 参数（默认不引入，整数类型，如：`5`）
2. 支持 `web_search_20250305` 工具流及引用源解析支持 ~~[TODO]~~
3. 支持 `anthropic-beta` header 设置，如： `ANTHROPIC_BETA_HEADERS="output-128k-2025-02-19,interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14"`
